subject.title: [Feature]: Support direct video upload to LLM

question: Should OpenClaw support provider-native video as a first-class chat/model input, and if so through which core/plugin contract and raw-media security/fallback policy?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix crosses product API shape, provider routing, model capability metadata, raw-media egress, retention, and fallback behavior that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve first-class video input
options.body: Define a WebChat/Gateway/model-catalog/provider contract with security limits and then land or replace the implementation accordingly.

options.title: Keep video in media-understanding only
options.body: Defer direct chat/model video uploads and document the supported video.description media-understanding path instead.

options.title: Prove providers first
options.body: Let provider-specific implementations such as MiniMax or Google validate native video behavior behind provider-owned seams before adding a generic core chat-video content contract.

recommendation.title: Approve first-class video input
recommendation.body: Define a WebChat/Gateway/model-catalog/provider contract with security limits and then land or replace the implementation accordingly.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest visible routing context on this issue and substantial adjacent media-understanding/provider history.
